meta.purpose: Group courses that train an actor's singing and voice-over, by town
meta.method: Each course was read from the provider's own page (readMethod 'page'); no price, day, time, duration, session count or date comes from a search summary alone. Search summaries and third-party listings (CourseHorse) were used mainly to find providers; the only details they supplied are two street addresses (City Lit, Acting & Voice Studios) and a level, each flagged in the notes. Pages were fetched with WebFetch or with curl and a text stripper (JSON-LD and raw HTML checked where a summariser could scramble figures). Where a provider page is script-rendered I read the data behind it: Neighborhood Music School's registration-system JSON, Gaiety School's WordPress API, City Lit's help-centre API (for the refund policy), and PDFs (Guildhall terms, Gaiety refund policy, CORus timetable) via pypdf. City Lit course pages return 403 to scripts and were read through WebFetch. Weekday uses 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday; every start date was checked against its weekday in code. startDate is the start of the next term whose dates are published; where only the term already running is published it is that term's start and notes say 'under way at dateRead'; it is null where the provider prints no usable date. taxIncluded is null throughout because no provider states it. Prices are the full course price in the provider's currency; the one derived total (Vancouver Acting School, 3 x 269.99) is flagged in its notes. Limits: the WebSearch tool reached its 200-call session budget during Dublin voice-over, so Toronto, Vancouver and Mexico City were covered only by direct fetches of known provider sites; Mexico City (both skills), Toronto and Dublin voice-over are therefore in notFound, and Toronto singing, Vancouver singing and Vancouver voice-over have one provider each rather than two. Several venues are in neighbouring municipalities (Pasadena, Burbank for Los Angeles; Hamden for New Haven) and are labelled as such.

notFound.searched: Searched for Dublin voice-over group courses (Gaiety School of Acting, The Lir Academy, other schools) and read the providers' own pages. Gaiety's only voice-over entries are 'Voiceover: Wednesday' (an 8-week online course, EUR 200, dated Aug-Sep 2022, long past) and 'Voiceover Masterclass' (one day, EUR 80, 21 Jun 2025). The Lir's 'Level 1 Voice-Over Acting' is a single weekend. None is a weekly multi-week course now on sale. Gaiety's one-to-one coaching (EUR 85 per hour, https://gaietyschool.com/one-to-one-coaching/) is general acting coaching and does not name voice-over, so it was not recorded as a private-lesson fallback. The WebSearch budget ran out here, so no further Dublin providers (for example private voice-over coaches) could be searched.

No Toronto voice-over group course could be verified. The WebSearch budget ran out before any Toronto voice-over search was made, so only direct probes of known provider sites were possible: ACTRA Toronto's events API lists no voice-over course (only a 3-day Vocal Combat workshop); Eventbrite's Toronto listing showed a single three-hour 'Commercial Voice Workshop' (Pirate Sound, 184 Front St E, Wed 14 Oct 2026, Katie Griffin), which is not a weekly course; The Second City Toronto lists only musical improv; Armstrong Acting Studios' class pages are script-rendered and unreadable by fetch; TMU Chang School's catalogue search returned HTTP 400, Humber's did not resolve and George Brown returned 403. No qualifying course and no private-lesson price could be verified.

No Mexico City singing course could be verified. The WebSearch budget ran out before Spanish-language searches were made; direct probes of guessed provider sites (Ollin Yoliztli, Casa del Lago UNAM, Facultad de Musica UNAM, Fermatta, INBAL) returned script-only pages, homepages with no course listings, or degree programmes only. No private-lesson fallback was recorded either.

No Mexico City voice-over / locucion / doblaje course could be verified. The WebSearch budget ran out before Spanish-language searches ('curso de doblaje', 'curso de locucion CDMX') were made; guessed provider domains did not resolve. No private-lesson fallback was recorded either.
